user.title: Connect to a Pulse-Eight matrix
user.description: Enter the matrix IPv4 address or hostname. No router changes or vendor account are needed. Status updates use local UDP; commands use HTTP. Internet blocking and network isolation are strongly recommended.

confirm.title: Discovered Pulse-Eight matrix
confirm.description: Connect to the discovered matrix at {host}. Confirm its address; a Docker proxy may report its own address instead.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the matrix. Check its address and wait for other requests to finish.
error.invalid_host: Use an IPv4 address or hostname without http://, port or path.

abort.not_supported: This discovery address is not supported.

init.title: Pulse-Eight transport options
init.description: UDP is the normal update transport. Optional cloud listeners accept local connections and monitoring uploads; they never contact the vendor or change your router. Configure redirection separately. Raw UDP events are diagnostic data, not CEC receive events. Daily advisory firmware checks contact the vendor from HA and send the matrix serial, model, hardware family and firmware version over HTTP. They do not send logs, download or install firmware. Disable checks for a fully offline installation.

data.source_filter: Only accept listener connections from the matrix
data.trusted_sources: Additional trusted source addresses, comma separated (for example a NAT gateway)
data.firmware_check_enabled: Check vendor firmware metadata daily and notify
data.firmware_hardware: Firmware hardware family override (blank for automatic)

error.port_conflict: UDP, cloud TCP and monitoring ports must differ.
